en.title: Check signed Android releases before an in-place update
en.body: Compare the application IDs, version codes and signing certificates of two local standalone APKs. The receiver guide includes a two-release Fold7 test with saved progress and a corrected host callback.

zh.title: 在原地升级前核对两个 Android 发行包
zh.body: 比较本地独立 APK 的应用标识、版号和签名证书。交接指南记录了 Fold7 上两个连续版本的覆盖升级、进度恢复与宿主回调修正。
